issues.quote: Canonical is `https://kopikita.test/coffee/ijen/`. That URL returns a 301 to `/coffee/java-ijen/`.
Returns HTTP 200 with the title "Page not found" and a not-found message.
That URL returns a 302 (temporary) redirect to /coffee/bali-kintamani/.
`/id/` declares `hreflang="in"`. The code for Indonesian is `id`.
The Article JSON-LD ends with a trailing comma (`"author": {...},}`).
`/blog/page/2/` is in the sitemap but its canonical points at `/blog/`.
`/coffee/samples/` is in the sitemap but `robots.txt` says `Disallow: /coffee/samples/`.
Every `<lastmod>` is `2027-03-01`, which is after today's date (2026-10-22).
Same image, same description, near-identical copy, each with a self-referencing canonical.
The three farm photos use `data-src` and an IntersectionObserver script, with no `src` in the HTML.
The only link to it is a `<button onclick="location.href=...">` on /coffee/.
The home page and two blog posts link to https://kopikita.test/coffee/kintamani/.
Image on the contact page uses http://

wrong_findings.why_wrong: The raw HTML for /coffee/ has a self-canonical pointing to https://kopikita.test/coffee/.

wrong_findings.claim: The /visit/ page has no address on the page.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Its text says the cafe is on Jalan Raya Sayan; the footer also gives Jl. Raya Sayan 12, Ubud, Bali.

extra_true.finding: Flores Bajawa is not linked from /coffee/ or /shop/.
Flores Bajawa and the gift box lack Product schema; /visit/ lacks schema and the home page has only generic Organization markup.
The favicon URL returns 404 and no favicon is listed in the site files.
Product and blog pages lack breadcrumb markup.

notes: Found 17 of 20 planted issues; the /blog/page/2/ fix advice is wrong because the key calls for a self-canonical. The audit also includes the false /coffee/ canonical claim.
